title: Lithuania and nuclear weapons – level 1
paragraphs: Lithuania votes today to change its laws about nuclear weapons. Long ago, Lithuania says no to nuclear weapons in the country.

Now, leaders want to change the law to make the country safer. Lithuania is near Russia and Belarus. Both countries have big weapons. US President Donald Trump says that the US may build a military base in Lithuania. Local leaders like this idea.
But Russia is angry. Leaders make threats against Lithuania. Leaders in Lithuania want to stay strong and work closely with their friends to stay safe.
